slices.focus: Derek now owns first-year orientation content and early retention check-ins with family involvement
slices.summary: Derek's role solidifies into overseeing first-year orientation content and early retention check-ins for all incoming apprentices. He delivers a blunt orientation talk that frames attendance problems as predictable life obstacles (transportation, child care, schedule conflicts) rather than moral failures, and involves families directly by putting contact guidance in plain language. He wrestles with designing simple triggers for early intervention (first missed night, first no-call) that will survive a tired instructor on a bad day, and decides to keep family engagement primarily at orientation night rather than extending it throughout.
open_loops: Refining the plain-language packet based on family questions from orientation
Designing a one-page simple trigger system for early check-ins
Setting up a running list of top confusions from orientation Q&A
Balancing family involvement (first-night only) with apprentice adult responsibility
Keeping packet language aligned with spoken delivery style
decisions: Derek now oversees first-year orientation content and early retention check-ins for incoming apprentices, with a stronge
